scope: Exact original static native/PDB data and portable typed normalization; no audio or original executable execution.

pOwner.meaning: owner pointer; actual pointer lifetime is runtime state

layout.limits: Do not fabricate functor or trailing padding bytes to claim a complete memory image.

constructor_caution: The named RVA0x43450 SoundCue constructor is a COPY ctor: copies owner/name/valid from source; it does not establish default values. Actual inline stores inside WeaponData ctor establish all six cue semantic defaults.

source_normalization.literal_null: SGD_DeserializeSoundCue compares exact lowercase bytes null plus terminator (5-byte comparison). It assigns shared INVALID_CUE: owner=null,name=/EmptyCue,valid=false. This is distinct from omitted compiled default name empty.
source_normalization.ordinary_string: GetSoundCue retains empty string as empty. Any nonempty source string starting / or { is preserved; otherwise prepend /.
source_normalization.empty_cue: EMPTY_CUE_NAME initializer is /EmptyCue. INVALID_CUE initializer sets its event-description cache entry to0 and constructs owner=null,name=/EmptyCue,valid=false. Direct /EmptyCue or normalized EmptyCue use that known-invalid cache entry.
source_normalization.named_validity: GetSoundCue looks up normalized name in the event-description cache or calls AudioManager::LookupEventDescription when an AudioManager exists. Returned cue mValid is descriptionPointer!=null; returned owner begins null. Named cue validity cannot be inferred from the string alone.
source_normalization.cache_hash: The examined lookup computes a 32-bit multiply-then-XOR FNV-style hash from the normalized byte string. The mHash member is the functor type, not a serialized numeric hash value.
not_conflated: Explicit source empty string: empty name,but lookup validity unresolved without actual cache/bank evidence.
Case variants such as Null and absolute /null: ordinary normalized names,not the sentinel.
JSON null/non-string source: unsupported by portable string normalizer; not silently treated as original literal null.

typed_portable_helpers.unknown_value: None validity means unresolved lookup, not false; consumers must preserve that distinction.
typed_portable_helpers.defaults_provenance: native-soundcue-compiled-defaults.json gives every semantic byte store origin and records the seven unproven storage bytes per cue.
typed_portable_helpers.projection_default: ProjectileOffsetStart is separate Justification uint8,CENTER2,postassignment byte storeVA1800f7ff7; see dedicated record.

validation.compiled_default_export: pass,all six cue semantic owner/name/valid values checked against bounded sparse constant stores,not pre-zeroed storage
validation.source_normalizer: pass,case-sensitive sentinel,slash/GUID prefix,empty versus default,unresolved named validity,JSON-null rejection

remaining_unknowns: Actual FMOD bank loading, Android-compatible event graph playback,instance ownership,voice substitutions and dynamic event-description lifetime.
Typed default recovery for unrelated Thing/Life cue fields still needs their actual constructor-store evidence; do not generalize solely from the WeaponData inline defaults.
